messages:
Maya: quick a11y pass on Console > Project Insights filters. Found focus, keyboard, and ARIA nits.

Alex: can you summarize repro steps?

Maya: Tab into Filters bar, open date dropdown, try arrow nav between presets, check icon-only clear button, and run VoiceOver.

Maya: issues: weak/hidden focus on .filter-pill, icon is div (not focusable), combobox missing aria-expanded/controls, low-contrast placeholder text. CSS I saw:
```.filter-pill { background:#f6f7f9; color:#8a8f98; } .filter-pill:focus{outline:none}```

Maya: fixes I propose: use `--text-strong` for pill text or darken bg, restore focus using `--focus-ring`, convert icons to `<button aria-label="Clear">`, add `role="combobox" aria-expanded` and listbox/options with `aria-selected`, add `aria-live="polite"` for results count.

Olivia: i'll add keyboard e2e tests for tab order, arrow nav, Esc to close, and live region announcement.

Jules: check VoiceOver dup reads — avoid duplicate aria-label + hidden label. Keep single label ref.

Alex: i'll open a PR tomorrow with CSS + markup changes and include axe in CI.

a11y-bot: Reminder: run `npx @axe-core/cli --rules color-contrast,focusable,aria-valid` before merge.

Maya: thanks, i'll re-run VoiceOver/NVDA on the PR once up.
